blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Several Mangyans were among more than 200 delegates of the Lakbayan ng Timog Katagalugan who were arrested by the Philippine National Police Southern Police District in Muntinlupa City on November 15. Lakbayan 2026 was a protest caravan that was marching to Manila to air the grievances of basic‑sector groups from the Southern Tagalog region, including opposition to the proposed Pax Silica Initiative and the Luzon Economic Corridor, as well as concerns over the scheduled visit of United States President Donald Trump.
